about: Licences of every model file the ComfyUI TRELLIS.2 lane loads, read from their sources on the date given. lane_sidecar.py refuses a graph that loads a file with no row here. Findings: 3d-static-props/findings/2026-09-23-trellis2-lane-licence.md (asset-harness WI 1749). Re-read a source before relying on a row: licence texts change.

mit.name: MIT License
mit.note: Its notice duty covers copies of the software or weights, not what they generate.

dinov3.name: DINOv3 License (Meta)
dinov3.note: Two Meta texts differ. LICENSE.md (Last Updated 2025-08-19, also bundled in Meta's gated HF repositories) asks a redistribution of DINO Materials or derivative works to carry a copy of the Agreement. Meta's web page (https://ai.meta.com/resources/models-and-libraries/dinov3-license/, dated 2025-08-14) adds: prominently display 'Built with DINOv3' on a related website, user interface, blogpost, about page, or product documentation. Both restrict use: trade controls; no ITAR, military, nuclear, espionage or weapons end uses; no reverse engineering. Both name outputs apart from the Materials.

parts.name: NAF upsampler
parts.note: The weights carry no licence of their own; Apache-2.0 is inferred from the repository they are released from.

conditions: The repository tags a DINOv3 derivative MIT and serves it ungated; the DINOv3 License governs the DINOv3 part regardless (owner decision O1, WI 1749).

components.role: geometry estimation (field of view), Pixal3D arm

tooling.name: ComfyUI
tooling.note: Runs the generation; on the common reading (WI 1601, not legal advice) the GPL does not reach its outputs, and distributing the tool would bring it in.
